_说明: 一年里程碑卡池：10 张卡（春 3、夏 3、秋 2、冬 2）+ 1 次冬夜，外加 5 张教学卡 T01–T05（只进第 1 代、按序；only_tutorial 为 true，不进普通牌堆）。卡上数值是内容样例，按 GAMEPLAY §3 的幅度写；落字「水」的数值照 §2.4 的例子。新增字段：title=卡头标题（版式），tutorial=教学顺序号，only_tutorial=只用于教学，lock_choice=开局即进「刻」阶段且锁左右拖（教学第 3 张），trace=卡级迹（配合 lock_choice）。trace 表示选这一边后卡上出现的迹，target 是这条迹能刻成的字，tally_text 是事签文案。

cards.speaker: 管事的老人
cards.title: 火边这一夜
cards.text: 管事的老人把刻骨用的骨刀推到你面前。火边的人都看着你。

bone.speaker: 管事的老人
bone.body: 寨口有脚步。妇人背回一筐野果，等你拿主意。

hardship.speaker: 管事的老人
hardship.body: 难处先记着。寨口妇人背回野果——今冬紧不紧，就看这一筐。

en.title: Night by the Fire
en.speaker: Elder in charge
en.text: The elder who runs things slides the bone carving knife before you. Everyone by the fire is watching.
en.right: First ask what gets hard later

bone.speaker: Elder in charge
bone.body: Footsteps at the gate. A woman brings back a basket of wild fruit, waiting on your call.

hardship.speaker: Elder in charge
hardship.body: Keep the hard parts in mind. A woman at the gate brings wild fruit—whether winter bites hangs on this basket.

cards.speaker: 采集的妇人
cards.title: 她背回一筐野果
cards.text: 族人等你拿主意。「分给他们，还是先存着？」

bone.title: 她背回一筐野果
bone.text: 族人等你拿主意。「分给他们，还是先存着？」

hardship.title: 她背回一筐野果
hardship.text: 「粮会紧。这筐果先囤过冬，还是分掉？」

store.speaker: 管事的老人
store.body: 果先囤下了。夜里摸骨片，你才看见那道裂。

share.speaker: 管事的老人
share.body: 果分完了。有人拿骨片来记，才摸到一道裂。

en.title: She Brings Back Wild Fruit
en.speaker: Foraging woman
en.text: The clan waits on your call. "Share it out, or store it first?"

bone.title: She Brings Back Wild Fruit
bone.text: The clan waits on your call. "Share it out, or store it first?"

hardship.title: She Brings Back Wild Fruit
hardship.text: "Grain will run short. Store this fruit for winter, or share it now?"

store.speaker: Elder in charge
store.body: The fruit is stored. At night you touch the bone slip and feel the crack.

share.speaker: Elder in charge
share.body: The fruit is shared out. Someone brings a bone slip to mark it—and finds a crack.

trace.tally_text: 晌午正热，赶路的背抵着一截老干，头顶叶子遮着太阳，一直待到天色转凉
trace.tally_text_en: Noon heat. The traveler leans his back on an old trunk; leaves shade him till the day cools.

store.title: 骨上有一道裂
store.text: 囤果时摸到骨上那道裂。「这道迹，刻下来，过冬也有底。」

share.title: 骨上有一道裂
share.text: 分完果，有人指着裂口。「刻下来，才像真记过。」

carve.speaker: 管事的老人
carve.body: 这道迹刻下了。没等干，两家又为河滩吵起来。

skip.speaker: 管事的老人
skip.body: 裂先搁着。寨外传来喊声——河水漫过了界石。

en.title: A Crack on the Bone
en.speaker: The ritual keeper
en.text: "This mark, carved, can be left for those after us."

store.title: A Crack on the Bone
store.text: Storing fruit, you feel the crack on the bone. "Carve this mark—winter has a hold."

share.title: A Crack on the Bone
share.text: Fruit shared, someone points at the crack. "Carve it, or it hardly counts as kept."

carve.speaker: Elder in charge
carve.body: The mark is carved. Before it dries, two houses quarrel over the river flat.

skip.speaker: Elder in charge
skip.body: The crack waits. Shouts outside the gate—river water has climbed past the boundary stone.

cards.speaker: 管事的老人
cards.title: 河水漫过了界石
cards.text: 两家为一条河争了三天。

carve.title: 河水漫过了界石
carve.text: 迹刚刻完，两家为一条河争了三天。

水.label: 河滩分开
水.note: 拿来一个像水的形，落到这张卡上。

skip.title: 河水漫过了界石
skip.text: 裂还搁着，两家已为一条河争了三天。

水.label: 河滩分开
水.note: 拿来一个像水的形，落到这张卡上。

yield.speaker: 管事的老人
yield.body: 各让一步，两边暂定。对方又来，要一半的粮。

hold.speaker: 管事的老人
hold.body: 这边守住了。对方改口，只要你们一半的粮。

river.speaker: 管事的老人
river.body: 河滩分开的形落下了。对方又派人来，要一半的粮。

drops.label: 河滩分开
drops.note: 拿来一个像水的形，落到这张卡上。

en.title: River Over the Boundary Stone
en.speaker: Elder in charge
en.text: Two houses have fought over one river for three days.

水.label: Split the river flat
水.note: Take a water-shaped form and drop it on this card.

carve.title: River Over the Boundary Stone
carve.text: Mark just carved, two houses have fought over one river for three days.

水.label: Split the river flat
水.note: Take a water-shaped form and drop it on this card.

skip.title: River Over the Boundary Stone
skip.text: Crack still waiting, two houses have already fought over one river for three days.

水.label: Split the river flat
水.note: Take a water-shaped form and drop it on this card.

yield.speaker: Elder in charge
yield.body: Each gave a step; both sides hold for now. They come again, asking for half the grain.

hold.speaker: Elder in charge
hold.body: This side held. They change their ask—only half your grain.

river.speaker: Elder in charge
river.body: The split-flat form is down. They send people again, asking for half the grain.

cards.speaker: 外族来使
cards.title: 他们要一半的粮
cards.text: 给了，今冬难熬；不给，怕要抡棍棒。

open.title: 他们要一半的粮
open.text: 河滩松了口。给了，今冬难熬；不给，怕要抡棍棒。

hold.title: 他们要一半的粮
hold.text: 这边没让。给了，今冬难熬；不给，怕要抡棍棒。

refuse.speaker: 管事的老人
refuse.body: 粮留下了。这一季的事，先记到这儿。

half.speaker: 管事的老人
half.body: 一半交出去了。这一季的事，先记到这儿。

en.title: They Want Half the Grain
en.speaker: Envoy from outside
en.text: Give it, and winter bites hard; refuse, and they may raise clubs.

open.title: They Want Half the Grain
open.text: The river flat went soft. Give it, and winter bites hard; refuse, and they may raise clubs.

hold.title: They Want Half the Grain
hold.text: This side did not yield. Give it, and winter bites hard; refuse, and they may raise clubs.

refuse.speaker: Elder in charge
refuse.body: The grain stays. This season's matters stop here for now.

half.speaker: Elder in charge
half.body: Half went out. This season's matters stop here for now.

cards.speaker: 管事的老人
cards.title: 春汛退了
cards.text: 春汛退了，河滩露出一大片软泥。管事的老人想趁早全族下滩抢种。

en.title: Spring Flood Goes Down
en.speaker: Elder in charge
en.text: The spring flood has gone down. Soft mud stretches across the river flat. The elder who runs things wants the whole clan down there early to plant.

cards.speaker: 采集的妇人
cards.title: 北坡塌下去一块
cards.text: 一夜大雨，北坡塌下去一块。她说坡下露出了怪东西，没人敢过去看。

trace.tally_text: 坡上的土被雨冲开，那截老干脚下露出一团盘结的须，顺着往深处挖，越挖越粗，最粗的一股一直扎进石缝里
trace.tally_text_en: Rain washed the dirt off. Under that old trunk, a knot of roots shows—dig deeper and they thicken; the thickest drives into the rock crack.

en.title: North Slope Slides
en.speaker: Foraging woman
en.text: One night of hard rain, a chunk of the north slope slid. She says something strange shows under the slope. Nobody dares go look.

cards.speaker: 巫
cards.title: 播种前要祭河
cards.text: 播种前，巫要拿一头小牲口祭河。

en.title: Offer to the River Before Sowing
en.speaker: The ritual keeper
en.text: Before sowing, the ritual keeper wants a small animal offered to the river.

cards.speaker: 东岸的使者
cards.title: 猎场上的套
cards.text: 东岸的猎手趁水浅过了河，在我们的猎场上下了套。

en.title: Snares on Our Hunting Ground
en.speaker: Envoy from the east bank
en.text: East-bank hunters crossed while the water was low and set snares on our hunting ground.

cards.speaker: 北山来的赶路者
cards.title: 热得走不动了
cards.text: 一个北山来的赶路者走到村口，热得走不动了。

trace.tally_text: 晌午正热，赶路的背抵着一截老干，头顶叶子遮着太阳，一直待到天色转凉
trace.tally_text_en: Noon heat. The traveler leans his back on an old trunk; leaves shade him till the day cools.

en.title: Too Hot to Keep Walking
en.speaker: Traveler from North Mountain
en.text: A traveler from North Mountain reaches the village gate, too hot to walk on.
en.left: Let him stay till it cools

cards.speaker: 守堤的老汉
cards.title: 河水涨过了土坎
cards.text: 夜里河水涨过了第二道土坎，再涨就要漫进粟地。

en.title: River Past the Dirt Bank
en.speaker: Old man on the dike
en.text: At night the river climbed past the second dirt bank. Higher, and it floods the millet fields.
en.left: Whole clan to the high slope

cards.speaker: 族里最壮的汉子
cards.title: 粟车陷进泥里
cards.text: 满满一车粟陷进了泥里，几个后生推不动。

trace.tally_text: 他把耒插进车轮底下的泥里，弯腰往上撬，胳膊上的筋一条条鼓起来，车轮一点点出了泥
trace.tally_text_en: He drives the plow-stick under the wheel into the mud, pries up; cords stand out on his arms; the wheel creeps free.

en.title: Millet Cart Stuck in Mud
en.speaker: Strongest man in the clan
en.text: A full cart of millet is stuck in the mud. A few young men can't push it free.

cards.speaker: 北山的人
cards.title: 拿牛骨换粟种
cards.text: 北山的人赶着两头牛来，想拿牛骨换我们的粟种。

en.title: Trade Cow Bone for Millet Seed
en.speaker: People from North Mountain
en.text: People from North Mountain drive two cattle over. They want to trade cow bone for our millet seed.

cards.speaker: 巫
cards.title: 冬祭要一片骨片
cards.text: 冬祭到了。巫要一片骨片去占来年的收成。

trace.tally_text: 冬祭那夜你守在河边，天上只剩弯弯一牙，又细又亮，照在冰面上像一把镰
trace.tally_text_en: Winter-rite night by the river. Only a thin bright crescent left in the sky, shining on the ice like a sickle.

en.title: Winter Rite Needs a Bone Slip
en.speaker: The ritual keeper
en.text: Winter rite is here. The ritual keeper wants a bone slip to read next year's harvest.

cards.speaker: 管事的老人
cards.title: 清点过冬的粮
cards.text: 雪下了三天，管事的老人要清点过冬的粮，看够不够撑到开春。

drops.label: 围着一堆柴同吃同睡
drops.note: 落字样例，数值待玩法稿确认

en.title: Count the Winter Grain
en.speaker: Elder in charge
en.text: Snow has fallen three days. The elder who runs things wants a count of winter grain—will it last till spring?

winter_night.note: 冬季最后一张卡之后进入冬夜；冬季两张卡的先后按种子洗牌，所以不绑定某一张卡
